Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, we're no longer able to make address changes on our end. As outlined in our **[kb/02-shipping-policy.md]**, address changes are only possible **before** the order ships — after that, you'll need to **contact the carrier directly** to request a delivery address update or redirect.

Here are a few tips:
- Check your shipping confirmation email for the carrier name (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS) and tracking number.
- Most major carriers have an online portal or customer service line where you can request a package redirect or hold for pickup.

If you run into any trouble with the carrier, feel free to reach back out and we can try to help further!
